SIGNAL.name: glb_ps__end_of_flux
SIGNAL.description: CS current headroom below 4.5 kA (ours, early on purpose: in run E the headroom fell from 5.27 kA at 115.8 s to 4.6 kA at 121.5 s (about 0.12 kA/s) and to 2.5 kA at 130.58 s, so 4.5 kA fires at about 122 s, 25 s before the DINA ramp-down start and leaving the whole termination inside the window); release 4.7 kA (hysteresis, moot under the latch); no debounce (not representable in the PSC global monitoring anyway)

SIGNAL.name: glb_ps__z_excursion
SIGNAL.description: current-centre Z more than 8 cm away from its reference (ours: run E showed a 4 cm geometric-axis excursion at the hard-segment entry and a 12 cm drift during the 0.61 MA/s termination; 8 cm is meant to stay silent during the overlay ramp-down and to catch a termination drift); release 4 cm (hysteresis), no latch so that z_hold can recover; reference = current-centre Z of the student's inverse run at 115.817598 s (job 1319725, see Zpl_ref). NOTE: the design current centre of that run falls with the nominal ramp-down (0.604 m at 136.8 s, 0.510 m at 155.4 s, 0.446 m at 160.5 s, 0.306 m at 176.4 s), so if the plasma follows the wrapper's time-based Z reference the event is expected to fire around 157-160 s (during segment 42): part of the story
